name: Mucous Cloud
description: While underwater, the aberration is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches the aberration or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 ft. of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for 1d4 hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater.
